text:
Alice K: Quick sync — product wants a long-term plan for multi-region routing and tenant isolation. Key asks: firm SLOs per customer tier, soft and hard isolation knobs, and launch criteria. can eng propose options?
Ben T: +1. We should outline tradeoffs: strict tenant isolation vs bin-packing efficiency.
Carol M: For strict isolation we need dedicated slices or node taints — more infra cost but clearer SLA.
Darren S: If we go soft isolation (traffic shaping + quotas) we keep utilization high but risk noisy neighbor latency spikes.
Emma R: any hard customer asks that force strict isolation?
Alice K: 2 compliance customers asked for network isolation and dedicated pools. Also sales mentions latency-sensitive fintech use cases.
Ben T: Proposal: three policy modes - shared (best-efficiency), soft-isolation (quota + priority), dedicated (tenant pinned).
Carol M: Agree. Need rollout plan: start with soft + canary dedicated pools for top customers.
Darren S: Metrics to track: p50/p95 per-tenant, evicted requests, cold-start rate, cross-tenant KV cache hit rate.
Infra Bot: deploy noticed: infra-canary/region-eu-1 completed 13:02 :rocket:
Ben T: For routing policies, we should support policy composition: region -> tier -> affinity. e.g. prefer local region, fallback to dedicated in same region, then fallback global.
Carol M: Example config snippet:
```
policy {
  prefer: locality
  fallbacks: [dedicated_same_region, shared_global]
  isolation: soft
}
```
Darren S: We also need migration guardrails: live traffic mirroring, slow rollout, automatic rollback if p95 increases > 20% for two cohorts.
Emma R: Launch criteria suggestion: (1) perf regressions <5% across critical prompts, (2) isolation leakage test pass, (3) autoscale + billing validated.
Alice K: Can eng owners produce a one-pager with cost delta estimates for each mode + migration checklist? Target EOD next Tue.
Ben T: I'll draft cost model. Carol will take isolation tests. Darren will own rollout automation.
Carol M: Adding: need SRE runbook for on-call handling of cross-tenant incidents.
Emma R: I'll coordinate customer comms and support playbooks.
Darren S: Sounds good. If no blockers, I'll schedule architecture review slot Thurs.
Alice K: Thanks all. Posting this to the roadmap doc after review. :thumbsup:
